a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance every round, our plan (2 operate rounds, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks the agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you to take 4. If you'd rather split differently, say so and I'll listen.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. If you also took, the split was random. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If I ended up with more than 4, tell me and I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
